text: Visitors have raised concerns about the heavy reliance on AI in the exhibits, with some feeling the experience lacked substantive historical content and was not accessible to taller guests. Several reviews mentioned poor lighting and insufficient signage, which made navigating the museum difficult and frustrating. The timed entry system caused confusion, with advice emerging that arriving later than a booked time can reduce wait times. Food service received negative comments, particularly about quality and wait times. Despite these issues, the overall average rating remains high, and many visitors noted the interactive exhibits and architecture.
